original_test_intent: Stress the complete SUT power/boot path for the approved eight-hour campaign, capture full PCIe and firmware state after every successful boot, detect hangs or any state drift, and prove final usability.
original_method: Pin SUT/BMC/PDU identities and expected inventory; define power actor, exact shutdown/power-on semantics, cycle cadence/count and eight-hour clock; preserve baseline logs rather than clearing them; drain jobs; execute each operator-approved cycle with console/OOB watchdog; collect full lspci -vv, GPU/firmware and health deltas; stop on hang/change; verify final services and hardware health.
manual_activity: Engineer resolves duration and power semantics; operator owns maintenance, each power action and OOB recovery; agent may collect and compare evidence after confirmed boots.
required_inputs: Authoritative eight-hour versus thirty-minute duration and cycle schedule
Exact AC/DC, PDU, BMC, shutdown-plus-power-on or reboot action
SUT/BMC/PDU identity, console/OOB access and job-drain approval
Expected full PCIe/GPU and firmware field/value manifest
Boot/reconnect timeout, stop criteria, evidence storage and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Never infer or automatically repeat a power action
Drain jobs and confirm target/power path before every cycle
Preserve existing logs and credentials; do not use literal admin or sshpass examples
Stop on boot timeout, management loss, inventory drift, storage/error or thermal/power fault
Use only approved OOB recovery and require engineer disposition before resume
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, schedule, inventory and recovery gates
Collect immutable per-cycle boot, lspci, firmware and health evidence
Compare every snapshot with normalized baseline and stop on change
engineer_actions: Resolve source conflicts and approve duration, action, schedule and oracle

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Credentialed SSH plus NVIDIA-only grep omits full lspci -vv, firmware, eight-hour scheduling and power/recovery control.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After each explicitly approved power cycle and confirmed boot, collect complete lspci -vv plus approved firmware inventory and health/log deltas under a numbered-cycle journal; the operator performs power actions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Eight hours is preserved from Procedure and thirty minutes from Machine Time as an unresolved conflict; no cadence or count is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a monotonic campaign journal tying every authorized power event to console/PDU evidence, boot deadline, complete normalized inventory and final recovery proof.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes state transitions and drift comparison measurable without narrowing evidence to NVIDIA devices.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A reboot script is not automatically equivalent to AC or platform power cycling; both source branches remain visible.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated power loss can corrupt state or strand the host; absence of a snapshot is a failure to observe, not proof of no change.

project_override_considerations: Platform owner defines power mechanism, safe cadence, expected inventory normalization and approved firmware fields for this SKU.
expected_evidence: Approved duration/action/cycle schedule and SUT/BMC/PDU identities
Baseline and every-cycle full lspci -vv/GPU/firmware inventory
Power, console, boot/reconnect timestamps and cycle IDs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure explicitly requires eight hours, Machine Time says thirty minutes, and the linked reboot-cycle script does not establish the stated power-reset mechanism.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution remains gated by project decisions and user confirmation rather than unresolvable source identity.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row261 Wistron-NV GPU-00254-V003: select authoritative duration (Procedure eight hours versus Machine Time thirty minutes), exact power action and relationship to reboot-cycle_hour, cycle count/interval, complete firmware fields and normalized lspci comparison oracle, boot timeout and OOB recovery contract.

review_improvement: Preserves every-cycle full PCIe and firmware coverage, exposes duration/action conflicts, and makes missing evidence, hangs and final recovery explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: A reboot, graceful shutdown plus power-on, BMC chassis cycle and AC removal exercise different rails, controllers and firmware activation paths. Comparing only NVIDIA lines can miss bridges, switches and link-width/speed drift. Eight hours cannot be reconciled with a thirty-minute machine estimate without authority, and a missing post-boot record must not be interpreted as unchanged inventory.
